title: What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bower
question:
What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bowery on 2013/7/12?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Landon Donovan's refers to player_name = 'Landon Donovan'; Jordan Bowery refers to player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'; percentage refers to DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(player_name = 'Landon Donovan' overall_rating; player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' overall_rating), player_name = 'Landon Donovan' overall_rating)*100

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  (
    (SELECT pa.XCL_132
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
     WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND pa.XCL_131 = '2013-07-12')
    -
    (SELECT pa.XCL_132
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
     WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND pa.XCL_131 = '2013-07-12')
  ) * 100.0 /
  (SELECT pa.XCL_132
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
   WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Jordan Bowery'
     AND pa.XCL_131 = '2013-07-12')

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.XCL_132 END)
          - MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.XCL_132 END)) AS REAL)
       / MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.XCL_132 END) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_123 IN ('Landon Donovan','Jordan Bowery')
  AND pa.XCL_131 = '2013-07-12 00:00:00'
